nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Moisture Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say the cream is too light to stop flaking and tightness, and one whose skin also has rosacea reports it left her drier than before and triggered a flare-up, while others with dry skin say it visibly softens flaky patches and leaves skin comfortable outside of very cold weather.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no stinging, redness, or breakouts, including on a compromised or reactive barrier, though a few describe stinging or a burning sensation that they link to the fragrance.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or oily-T-zone skin say the cream absorbs quickly, controls shine, and keeps skin balanced without breakouts, including under powder or makeup.
segments.normal: The reviewers who describe their skin as normal or dry-to-normal find the cream lightweight yet hydrating in mild conditions, though one needed a heavier product once temperatures dropped well below freezing.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who mentions her skin changing with age says the cream is gentle enough to use every day.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the cream visibly relieves dryness, reducing flaky patches and leaving skin soft and plump within days, though several reviewers with very dry skin found it too lightweight, reporting it did nothing for their dryness or left skin even drier, particularly in cold weather or with prolonged exclusive use.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness say the cream calms or reduces it, including one with a damaged barrier and one with generally reactive skin who saw no redness or itching at all; the exception is a reviewer with rosacea whose redness flared up more than usual while using this cream as her only product.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing a compromised or sensitive barrier, including one recovering from over-exfoliation, say the cream was gentle and comfortable, and one reports her moisture barrier visibly improved after use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who are acne-prone report the cream does not trigger new breakouts and can be layered over acne treatments like retinol or benzoyl peroxide without added irritation, though one reviewer with active acne found it stung on application.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin say the cream absorbs without leaving grease or shine and stays put under powder, with no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Feels heavy or slow to absorb for some
Fragrance is light or unnoticeable for most
Fragrance stings sensitive skin for a few users
Layers well under makeup and sunscreen
Pump dispenses too much product at once

extraits.texte: I have dry skin with rosacea. My old moisturizer has been good to me for years but lately it hasn't been as effective as it used to be so decided to try something new. I was on the fence between skin1004 and another brand. The skin1004 brand has been popular with more reviews, so in the end, i decided to try this hyalu-cica moisture cream. It was lightweight, had a slight fragrance, and applied easily on the face. Perhaps it was too lightweight though, that i felt it wasnt absorbing properly. I tried this for roughly 3 months. The first month, i noticed that it wasnt as hydrating as my last moisturizer, but i assumed it was because i was changing things up. Second month rolled along and my face was getting dry. At that point, I thought maybe theres something in this that wasnt reacting well with my other skin care routine (just a cleanser and serum) so i decided to test things out and removed everything but this moisturizer for a month. The result was kinda surprising. My face have never been so dry before. I was getting patches of flaky skin on my face. My rosacea flared up more aggressively than usual. For a moisturizer that was suppose to be hydrating and calming that can lasts up to 100 hours, i had to moisturize every 2-3 hours, and even then, i wake up dryer than the day before. It was crazy. So yeah, definitely not for me. It did not do what it said it was supposed to do. I went back to my old moisturizer and it kinda fixed the problem but like I said in the beginning,

extraits.titre: Tingling and burning of the skin with strong cherry fragranc
extraits.texte: I have an overall sensitive skin. When purchasing I go for items usually with little to no fragrance but when trying I noticed a strong artificial cherry scent for the moisturizer. When applied to the skin I'm left with a burning tightening feeling

I'm currently going through chemotherapy. That has caused my skin to be extremely sensitive and dry on a level I did not know was possible. This product is not irritating and doesn't seem to have fragrance. However, it is not moisturizing enough. I have been using this for two months and see no improvements in my skin. I did have to add a facial oil and hyalauronic acid serum so my face wouldn't dry out. For the price, this would be great for someone with sensitive skin but doesn't have issues with excessively dry skin. If I weren't going through chemo, I might buy again.

extraits.titre: Great for Humid Weather, Just a Bit Light for Winter
extraits.texte: I've been using this cream with my oily-combination skin in a really humid climate, and overall I'm impressed. It absorbs quickly without leaving any grease, and it keeps my skin calm and balanced throughout the day. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars is because it's just a bit too light for winter, my face starts to feel a little tight when the air gets dry. If it were a touch more moisturizing during colder months, it'd be perfect. Still, for everyday use in warm, humid weather, it's a great option.

WOW. I have extremely sensitive skin, like even applying something to my face makes it red, even water makes it red. Ive tried TONS of moisturizers, i saw this in stores and decided to swithc it up because it has clean ingredients, alcohol and fragrance free. And holy moly im never going back. I applied this and instantly my moisturizer barrier was improved. It caused no redness or itching while applying which is so rare for me to find. It feels light but very reparing and looks great on the skin, please try it and if it doesnt work you can return it, but its so worth it for everyone and im so grateful i found this product

extraits.titre: Dry acne prone skin girlies, this is it!
extraits.texte: I've been using this moisturizer for about a month now and can confirm that it doesn't cause breakouts – my biggest problem when I try new products. As shown in the pictures, no new breakouts occurred overnight, what it usually happens in my case. My overall experience was great and I use it not only overnight, but as a primer for makeup, which helps protecting the skin from developing more breakouts. 10/10, will definitely buy again and recommend to my friends.

My skin has been having some uncomfortable, unsightly patches of flaking and redness. I have tried at least ten different moisturizers and nothing helped with the redness or flaky patches. I had received this product as a free step-up gift a while back and gave it a try. I experienced zero burning (yes!) and no redness. I did still have some flaky dry skin areas. After three days, the patchy dry areas are totally gone. I came here to purchase a tube, and the price point is so much less than anything I've used.
